name: floatlist-workspace
description: FloatList desktop app, Feishu sync gateway, and shared protocol.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @floatlist/contracts build && pnpm --filter @floatlist/gateway build && pnpm --filter @floatlist/desktop build
scripts.lint: eslint apps/gateway/src apps/gateway/test packages/contracts/src packages/contracts/test --max-warnings=0 && pnpm --filter @floatlist/desktop lint
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @floatlist/contracts test && pnpm --filter @floatlist/gateway test && pnpm --filter @floatlist/desktop test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @floatlist/contracts test:coverage && pnpm --filter @floatlist/gateway test:coverage && pnpm --filter @floatlist/desktop test:coverage
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @floatlist/contracts check && pnpm --filter @floatlist/gateway check && pnpm --filter @floatlist/desktop check
scripts.verify: pnpm check && pnpm lint && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm build && pnpm audit && pnpm rust:fmt && pnpm rust:check && pnpm rust:test && pnpm rust:clippy
